priority_definitions.P0: 원본 상태/동일 이미지/특수 Java 렌더러/버전 선택의 모델링 해석 충돌을 먼저 해결. P0 전체 신규 촬영 의무가 아니라 원본 소스와 기존 게임 증거로 분리 심사.
priority_definitions.P1: 과거 F2 재사용, 위험 시나리오 단계별 원본, JSON 해시 표기 정합을 재검토. H7/H8 증거 재사용 금지 아님; 독립 실행으로 중복 계산 금지.
priority_definitions.P2: 기존 F2 로그/모델/부모/UV/프레임 재정합이 우선. 신규 게임 촬영은 문서상 객관적 증거가 모자랄 때만 제한적으로 지정.

review_order: 70 targets original run/artifact ID and SHA unchanged; use H3/H6 ledger as starting record
per case exact released version, model/parent tree, blockstate options and source exception disposition
link exact original server stage and same native F2 filename+SHA+frame timestamp or sequence; H6 flags are traceability, not causal proof
independently inspect original pixel scene of relevant case and distinguish visible geometry from hidden/unknown UV or renderer
classify exact scope as PASS_SCOPED / CONDITIONAL / HOLD with explicit evidence and failure grounds; no blanket 70/70 full approval
if irreducible ambiguity affects the modeling study, schedule narrow single source-controlled game reproduction, preserving original and patch SHA
keep gameplay interaction / survival mode / water physics outside mandatory MODEL_UV contract unless research explicitly includes them
risk_corrections: R01:S10 one representative; not all furniture
R02 and R07 share original four AF variant3 F2 images; H15/H16 later tests only specific acacia_1 north cases
R03 H7 setblock-only original states supplemented by new H8 actual player click GUI F2: do not request repeat for identical scope
R04 static water-state F2 differs from R06 time-separated source F2; neither automatically proves water physics
R05 original stages combine two distinct actual game runs, not one uninterrupted gameplay recording
R08 Git source-build 4.0.3/official 4.0.2 parity is only north variant1 representative; not 88-state or modwide
limitations: No new original ZIP/JAR/PDF/image bytes reopened by this TRIAGE alone: it faithfully joins immutable previously audited H3/H6/H7/H8/H16 materials, not a fresh H05 visual adjudication.
Original F11F ledger already recorded human visual observations for many cases; H3/H6 flag refers to new per-case reapproval, not that nobody ever saw original F2.
H6 no target-level exact metadata for six risk IDs was narrowed by H7 source substage checks; their F contracts remain conditional, not proof of total lack of stage evidence.
Priority is research workflow proposed from case deficits, NOT official F/H gate status or preapproval.
No new original Minecraft game executions or new F2 are claimed.
R03 H8 confirms creative GUI scripted item-placement/removal; no survival/universal interaction pass.
Modeling and UV-focused research is not automatically required to pass sleep/wake/destroy, or obtain third-party redistribution/training rights as a geometric result.
Original source materials, authored mod assets and game screenshots not duplicated into Git.
